item.title: Configuring vCenter Orchestrator (vCO) with PowerShell over HTTPS with Kerberos Authentication
item.description: As a PowerShell fan I find using the vCO PowerShell plugin makes my life a whole lot easier. What isn’t easy however, is  the configuration of vCO and a PowerShell jump host. Having done it a few times, this is my method for ensuring a secure working connection using HTTPS and Kerberos.
